evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images.
